youtube.title: Jeans mein ye chhoti si pocket kyun hoti hai? 👖 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapki jeans ki front right pocket ke andar ek chhoti si pocket hoti hai. Itni chhoti ki na phone aaye, na chabi. Phir ye hai kis liye?

1800s mein Levi Strauss ne miners, cowboys aur railroad workers ke liye mazboot work pants banayi thi. Tab wrist watch aam nahi thi, to log chain wali pocket watch rakhte the. Badi pocket mein watch ghis jaati, dab jaati ya kho jaati, isliye ye chhoti pocket joda gaya. Watch chali gayi, par pocket reh gayi.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
